name: Trailing record
rule: Over the trailing 50 graded decisions, contest win rate <= 0.50 AND the exact binomial p >= 0.05.
measurement: Trailing contest win rate and p are computed every build from the reserved window.

name: Baseline regression
rule: Trailing 30 decisions: MAE worse than the no-knowledge baseline (delta < 0).
measurement: MAE delta is computed every build; the trailing-30 slice is printed as soon as n allows.

name: Drawdown
measurement: UNEVALUABLE — needs a settled payoff series (F-01). Recorded, not waived.

name: Provenance break
rule: Any input row loses its official source link, or a source fetch fails.
measurement: Checked by scripts/verify_signals.py on every build and in CI.

name: Under-powered
rule: Fewer than 30 graded decisions since promotion.
measurement: Promotion itself requires the sample-size gate, so this is a safety net.

name: Look-ahead
rule: Any input is found to be published after the decision cutoff for the graded game.
measurement: Structurally prevented by the walk-forward fit; checked by re-running G10.

name: Closing-value collapse
rule: Fair line stops being closer to the truth than the baseline in 3 consecutive weeks.
measurement: Weekly contest win rate is printed on the leaderboard page.
